intro: Mauritian culture blends Indian, African, Chinese and French influences.

chapters.title: Sega
text: Sega music, with roots among enslaved Africans, is on UNESCO's list. Diwali, Chinese New Year and Christmas are all celebrated.

chapters.title: Food
text: Dholl puri, a flatbread with curry, and rougaille, a tomato sauce, are favourites.
